  PROBLEM: `_post_state_comment_v2_chunk` assumes `jq` is available in PATH.
  WHY: If `jq` is missing, chunk posting fails; one reviewer said the workflow prerequisite check covers this, but the function itself has no local guard.

  WHY: The regex only accepts positive integers, so a documented disable value of 0 would be clamped to 1080; other reviewers said this is intentional and no 0-disable contract exists.
